# PanePilot v0.2.0-rc.1

This is the first release candidate for PanePilot 0.2.

## Highlights

- Discover PanePilot-owned remote tmux sessions from another laptop without installing
  a remote daemon.
- Reattach remote terminals automatically after SSH loss or laptop wake. The terminal
  remains mounted while PanePilot reports reconnecting or offline state, and a manual
  retry is available.
- Restore current Codex activity after reconnect using its `run-state` and
  `task-progress` status-title data.
- Create reusable project Actions: editable shell commands that run in fresh ephemeral
  tmux sessions and show only their latest run output.
- Open one persistent, tmux-backed Codex Q&A workspace from each project's top tabs.
- Distinguish terminal profiles with icons.
- Keep the Files workspace open state and editor draft when switching project tabs
  during the current app session.
- Restore scrolling in the file browser.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads.

## First-launch note

This candidate is not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm the
launch. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this GitHub repository.

New Codex sessions receive the status-title configuration used for reconnect snapshots.
An already-running Codex process created by an older PanePilot build must be restarted
before that specific status integration is available.
